import sys
from collections import Counter

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    if n == 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    arr = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
    freq = Counter(arr)
    max_count = max(freq.values())
    max_elems = [k for k, v in freq.items() if v == max_count]
    if len(max_elems) > 1:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(max_elems[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
